categories.label: Azure & Cloud
categories.description: Microsoft Azure and first-party cloud services — resource management, Cosmos DB, Fabric, Foundry, AKS, App Service, Cognitive Services, Entra.

categories.label: Browser Automation
categories.description: Driving, inspecting, or scraping web browsers — automation via accessibility trees, DevTools, headless control, page capture.

categories.label: Docs & Retrieval
categories.description: Fetching and searching documentation, knowledge, or the web — up-to-date code docs, semantic retrieval, RAG, web search.

categories.label: Data Stores
categories.description: Databases, vector stores, and search indexes — SQL/NoSQL, embeddings, full-text search, replication.

categories.label: Dev Tooling
categories.description: Software development workflow — source control, CI/CD, code intelligence, build/deploy, infrastructure-as-code, IDE/editor integration.

categories.label: Specialty
categories.description: Domain-specific servers that don't fit the other buckets — the explicit catch-all (format conversion, monitoring, payments, vertical SaaS, etc.).
